selection: Files the verified installer writes that the WinUI 3 payload no longer provides: the Qt Quick/QML frontend, retired Qt and OpenCV runtime files, assets and API-set DLLs that now ship at other paths, and the bundled 0.4.2 source ZIP. These paths were identified by comparing the complete silent installation with the WinUI 3 installer stage.
collectedWith: Silent install of the verified installer into an isolated desktop/build directory (/S /NoRegistration /NoShortcuts /D=...), enumerated from the installed tree (1957 files); leftover set computed as installed-tree paths absent from the accepted WinUI 3 portable payload. Cross-checked with '7z l <installer>'. Note: 7-Zip 9.10 beta under-reports this NSIS payload (1415 of 1957 files), so the installed tree, not the 7z listing, is authoritative.
